text: The applicant must be over 18 years old (inclusive) and under 45 years old (inclusive), in good health, comply with the relevant provisions of the "Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China", and be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. 2. According to the document No. 12 issued by the Ministry of Education (Educational Department Letter [2020] 12), it is stipulated: If both or one of the applicant's parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled in a foreign country, and the applicant was born with foreign nationality, they should hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years (inclusive) or more, and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years during the last 4 years (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). One year of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.
